en: Illustrated New Year postcard showing a smiling postman delivering letters to a young woman leaning over a stair railing. Above them are festive fir branches with white bells, and in the background is a large hilltop complex with cathedral spires and a palace-like building. At the bottom center is a red circle with "1941". Decorative cursive text in Czech appears along the lower margin, including a stamped purple name.
